witness: Budge's footnote on p. 203: 'For the text see Naville, Todtenbuch, Bd. I., Bll. 137, 138' — the Appendix is supplied from Naville's 1886 edition of the Theban Book of the Dead (vol. I, plates 137–138), not from the Papyrus of Ani; no other footnote in pp. 203–213 names a papyrus.
